Compute SLA skewness coefficients for an integrated occu fit

Source: R/sla_int_occu.R
dot-sla_compute_int_occu.Rd

Builds joint block-diagonal Sigma (Louis I_obs on the occ block, raw H_beta on each det_s block), then calls the generic FD primitive against the original-likelihood evaluator .loglik_int_occu.

Usage

.sla_compute_int_occu(model, em_result, spatial = NULL, prior_spec = NULL)

Arguments

model

A tobs_model (model_type = "integrated").

em_result

EM-Laplace return list (with $fits$occ, $fits$det1,...,$fits$det<S>, $weights).

spatial

Optional tobs_spatial. When set, the skewness correction is intentionally NOT applied (Gaussian marginals retained) for the same reason as the single-season path: the simplified-Laplace third-cumulant correction captures hyperparameter-free fixed-effect marginal skewness, but a spatial field's marginal skewness is dominated by hyperparameter-marginalisation, which the correction does not capture (validated against NUTS). The Gaussian fallback is the correct conservative behaviour, not a stub.

prior_spec

Optional prior spec; passed to .louis_info_psi_single() so the penalty enters Louis I_obs.

Value

list(gamma, valid, reason).
